docs.summary: Provides a pinned GameObject context for menu operations, either set explicitly or following the active selection.
Every GameObject a row menu was opened over, when more than one is selected; empty otherwise.
Returns the explicitly pinned GameObject for context menus, or the first selected GameObject when no pin is active.
Pins the context to the specified GameObject. When go is null, the pin is set to null and ActiveGameObject will return null.
Pins the context to the first of several GameObjects, remembering all of them for per-target items.
Drops the pin so the context follows the active selection again.
